The "Honor Economy": Custom weaponized against women
The System:
In impoverished regions, the patriarchal
family is the primary unit of survival
against rivals. Daughters are viewed
as economic liabilities until
bartered for dowries.
The Threat:
A raped woman loses "market value."
She becomes a symbol of the
family's vulnerability.
The "Cleansing":
To restore socio-economic standing and male
proprietary rights, the victim is exiled,
imprisoned (under laws requiring 4 male
witnesses to prove rape), or murdered by
male relatives (Honor Killings).

Objectivity is often just consensus bias.
The Dominant Paradigm Filter
Objective News
Background
Assumptions /
Dominant Paradigm
Raw Reality
The Mechanic:
We do not first see and then
define; we define first and then
see (Walter Lippmann).
The Result:
Notions that fit the dominant culture are
accepted as "objective facts." Dissident
views are rejected as
"ideological" simply
because they require evidence outside the
pre-approved background assumptions
The Ultimate Control:
The most powerful ideologies are
those never challenged because they
appear as the unadorned truth.
